course.title: Year 9 Graphics Technology
course.program_role: Year 1 allocation within the 200-hour Stage 5 elective

syllabus_basis.title: Communication Technology 7-10 Syllabus (2025)
syllabus_basis.implementation_status: 2027 planning candidate; approved early-adoption decision remains Teacher to confirm; mandatory from 2028

outcomes.statement: applies risk management and safe work practices in communication technology contexts
communicates ideas, concepts and solutions through design and production
selects and applies technical and practical skills for design and production
applies design principles, standards and conventions in the production of projects
designs products and solutions for a range of purposes and audiences
selects and uses equipment and software in the design, development and presentation of communication technology solutions
evaluates the purpose, functionality and environmental impacts of products and solutions
selects and applies processes for the planning and management of communication technology projects
assesses the impact of current and emerging technologies used in communication technology production

sections.title: Safe studio, instruments and line language
